Religion is not among them.

language.note: Cuba's census does not ask language or mother tongue: ONEI's list of every topic of the 2012 Censo de Población y Viviendas (Informe Nacional, section IV) has none.

median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from ONEI's count of the population by five-year age group at 31 December 2024.
ethnicity_note: Skin colour (color de la piel) as the 2012 Population and Housing Census recorded it for everyone counted -- 463,458 people here -- in its three categories: white (blanca), black (negra), and mulatto or mestizo (mulata o mestiza). In 2012 the question was put to the person answering, a self-classification; earlier censuses, 2002's included, had the enumerator record it by observation. Cuba's census asks no other identity question.
